calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from) mn, max(valid_from) mx
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-29' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (
  SELECT member_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS join_dates, min(join_date) AS jd_min, max(join_date) AS jd_max, min(valid_from) AS first_valid_from
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'members total' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with >1 join_date', count(*) FROM m WHERE join_dates > 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with first valid_from <> join_date', count(*) FROM m WHERE first_valid_from <> jd_min
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with any join_date 2026-10-03', count(*) FROM m WHERE jd_min = DATE '2026-10-03' OR jd_max = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with first valid_from 2026-10-03', count(*) FROM m WHERE first_valid_from = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi-version members', count(*) FROM m WHERE versions > 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'max join_date', 0 FROM m

calls.statement:
WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY join_date
